⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing Training with Fidel!

Fidel was fantastic with our Bernedoodle! He’s patient, knowledgeable, and truly understands dogs. Our pup is now calmer, better behaved, and happier. Fidel made the process easy and enjoyable—highly recommend him to anyone looking for a great trainer!

We especially appreciated how Fidel tailored the training to our dog’s personality and gave us clear guidance to continue progress at home. His passion for what he does really shows, and the results speak for themselves!
